subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw change gateway-host exec private-LAN reachability semantics?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing diagnostic, but allowing, blocking, or emulating same-user private-LAN access is a security and product boundary that automation should not choose.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving actual private-LAN access semantics unchanged and tracked in related security-policy issues.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Require a separate maintainer-owned security design before changing gateway-host exec private-LAN reachability.

options.title: Defer To Broader Policy Trackers
options.body: Reject the diagnostic-only scope and keep this behavior under the broader private-network policy issues.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving actual private-LAN access semantics unchanged and tracked in related security-policy issues.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history signal for the exec runtime/docs surface and adjacent host-routing behavior.
